items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I was engaged by Andy Kirk to replace a trumpeter named Clarence Trice. The position was not to be permanent but I stayed with the orchestra for four months

ctx.x: When the bus was rolling, there was a poker game going on until we reached our destination. We played some dates in Maryland, Delaware and Washington, D.C., where we played a river boat dance which was very agreeable at night, because the weather was about 110 in the shade during the time we were there. We stayed in D.C. for a couple of days before the tour ended. I've experienced having to push a car on different occasions on a tour, but this was the first time I helped push a bus and everyone taken it more so…

Beezie and I had not been getting along very well for quite some time and we finally separated. The last week of September, I was engaged by Andy Kirk to replace a trumpeter named Clarence Trice. The position was not to be permanent but I stayed with the orchestra for four months and enjoyed every moment.
